name: ArgoCDProject
description: Read Argo CD projects and manage project role tokens.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks/issues)

Use this to rotate the Argo CD credential your pipelines authenticate with. See the token rotation guide.
author: WayneGoosen

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Argo CD service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minting tokens needs a token with `update` permission on the project or account.

options.get: get - read one project and its roles
options.list-tokens: list-tokens - list token IDs on a role
options.create-token: create-token - mint a project role token
options.delete-token: delete-token - revoke a token by ID

inputs.name: role
inputs.label: Role
inputs.visibleRule: command = list-tokens || command = create-token || command = delete-token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Role within the project, for example `ado-ci`.

inputs.name: expiresIn
inputs.label: Expires in
inputs.helpMarkDown: Token lifetime: a number of seconds, or a number with a unit (`s`, `m`, `h`, `d`, `w`). **`0` means the token never expires.**

inputs.name: tokenId
inputs.label: Token ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: ID of the token to revoke, as reported by `create-token` or `list-tokens`.

outputVariables.name: token
outputVariables.description: The minted token. Secret; only available immediately after creation.

outputVariables.name: tokenId
outputVariables.description: ID of the minted token, used to revoke it later.

outputVariables.name: tokenCount
outputVariables.description: Number of tokens remaining on the role.

outputVariables.name: tokenIds
outputVariables.description: Comma-separated token IDs on the role.

outputVariables.name: roleCount
outputVariables.description: Number of roles on the project.
